title: Paid image confirmation contradicts requested ratio
reproduction: Request 4:5 image and wait for confirmation
expected: Unsupported ratio is blocked before a paid card; all displayed values match one validated job payload
actual: Otto prose says 4:5 while card says 2304x1728 4:3 and Generate is available
user_impact: User may spend credits on the wrong deliverable
recommended_repair: Render confirmation only from server-validated paid-job payload; fail closed on unsupported ratio
closure_evidence: Acceptance test proves 4:5 yields no paid card, then 3:4 narrative/card/payload match

title: Video starts before alternative-path decision is resolved
expected: All clarifications finish before approval; after approval only status is shown
actual: Job starts, then Otto asks single-step versus safer two-step
user_impact: Consent occurs before the real plan is settled
recommended_repair: Use explicit clarification/confirmation/approved/queued/running states and prevent post-start planning questions
closure_evidence: A/B choice appears before Generate; one approval produces one reservation and direct queued state

title: Official Avatar library and @ picker are absent
reproduction: Type @ in Canvas or open Add context
expected: Shared typed picker opens with Products, Characters, Official avatars, Locations, Clothes and Media
actual: No @ menu; Add context exposes upload and old media Library only
user_impact: Approved official-avatar journey cannot be completed
recommended_repair: Connect frozen reference-picker contract and read-only Official Avatar collection
closure_evidence: Select @Alya by keyboard, confirm immutable ID, prevent edit/delete, generate with it

title: Paid video confirmation hides actor reference
reproduction: Attach product and actor-like media; request video
expected: Confirmation lists every reference in actual job payload
actual: Composer has two references, card visibly lists only product
user_impact: User cannot verify inputs to a 14-credit job
recommended_repair: Render chips from exact job referenceIds and disable Generate on mismatch
closure_evidence: Two-reference job always shows two chips and re-quotes when one is removed

title: Conversation history omits latest video turn
reproduction: Generate image then video, expand history, reload
actual: History stops at image result while video node exists
user_impact: User cannot audit or safely resume work
recommended_repair: Persist one ordered conversation event stream and derive count from it
closure_evidence: Hard refresh and sign-in recovery show complete image and video history

title: Library uses retired taxonomy
expected: Generations, Uploads, Favorites, Collections and Elements with typed subcategories
actual: All, Images, Videos, Cast, Product assets and Ads
user_impact: Asset model cannot support reusable typed references
recommended_repair: Adopt frozen Library IA on production routes and shared asset model
closure_evidence: Every frozen section is route-backed, keyboard reachable and used by picker

title: Asset detail lacks origin and reference provenance
expected: Deep-link shows origin Canvas/chat, references, cost, status, usage and collections
actual: URL stays /library; engine prompt/references not reported
user_impact: Generated assets cannot be trusted or traced
recommended_repair: Route-back selection and expose full lineage plus trash/restore semantics
closure_evidence: Copied deep link restores detail and navigates to origin Canvas with two refs and 14-credit cost

title: Brand is retired Brand memory IA
expected: Brand voice, Audiences, Knowledge base, Style guide, Visual guidelines
actual: About brand, Look and feel, customers, products, offers, do/don't
user_impact: Backend Otto IQ cannot wire to approved frontend without rewrite
recommended_repair: Converge production routes and adapters on frozen five-section IA
closure_evidence: Five sections route correctly with section title/list/detail states

title: Otto IQ lacks draft-review-preview-save governance
expected: Source creates editable draft with evidence, preview and explicit save
user_impact: Source of truth can change without review
recommended_repair: Implement Text/URL/File source, extracted draft, Without/With preview and Save
closure_evidence: Cancel leaves saved state unchanged; Save records source and reviewed version

title: Global Otto opens unrelated stale Canvas
reproduction: Open Otto from Billing and expand
expected: New workspace/Billing-context thread or explicit resume choice
actual: Old Professional Male Model Canvas appears
user_impact: User may act with hidden wrong context
recommended_repair: Display explicit scope and separate page context from conversation identity
closure_evidence: Billing invocation never loads unrelated Canvas without explicit selection

title: Marketing-ready state cannot be reached through tested Connections
reproduction: Follow Home connect-source intent to Settings/Connections
expected: At least one supported beta source can feed marketing health
actual: Only social channels were available in inspected connection cards
user_impact: Core Home value may be unreachable
recommended_repair: Define and wire one supported sandbox source-to-Home path
closure_evidence: Connect test source, return to Home, observe ready/stale/error/recovery states

title: Staging exposes no immutable build identity
reproduction: Inspect UI, HTML and visible health/build surfaces
expected: Web SHA, worker SHA, artifact digest, migration frontier and timestamp are visible read-only
actual: Only mutable URL and HTML fingerprint are available
user_impact: Engineer cannot prove which deployment closed a defect
closure_evidence: Next report cites one immutable release identity from product

title: Change something dumps provider prompt
expected: User edits outcome fields or natural request
actual: Long provider-oriented prompt is placed in composer
recommended_repair: Keep structured fields/default natural language; hide provider prompt in advanced detail
closure_evidence: Change ratio/duration/reference without editing provider prompt

title: Raw prompts are used as card titles and accessible names
reproduction: Scan Library grid or accessibility tree
expected: Concise user-editable title with full prompt in detail
actual: Complete generation prompt is the card title
user_impact: Poor scanability and extremely verbose assistive navigation
recommended_repair: Generate concise title and keep full prompt as provenance
closure_evidence: Grid cards have short titles and screen-reader names under agreed length

title: Brand mark is broken on credential steps
expected: Same Fikirtive mark renders on every auth step
actual: Broken image icon appears beside wordmark
recommended_repair: Use versioned design-system asset with fallback and asset-load test
closure_evidence: Desktop/narrow screenshots render mark on all steps

title: Delete account copy mixes account, workspace and hiding
expected: One named resource and explicit permanence/retention consequences
actual: Delete account, Ending workspace and Hides workspace appear together
recommended_repair: Separate account and workspace operations; enumerate retained/deleted data
closure_evidence: Copy and confirmation name exact resource and recovery window

title: Save action is ambiguous
expected: Action label names actual state change
actual: Save appears although generation is already in Library
recommended_repair: Rename to Add to favorites or Add to collection
closure_evidence: Accessible label and resulting state are unambiguous

title: Invalid email shows duplicate validation treatments
actual: Browser bubble then app error block
recommended_repair: Choose one field/error-summary treatment and announce once
closure_evidence: One visible and programmatic error after invalid submit

title: Retired Project and Brand memory vocabulary remains
expected: Canvas, Library, Elements, Otto IQ and Workspace vocabulary is consistent
actual: Project and Brand memory remain in production copy
user_impact: Mental model and backend naming drift
recommended_repair: Centralize frozen product vocabulary in shared copy metadata
closure_evidence: Search and UI acceptance show retired terms absent from beta routes
